title: YET, HEARD
lines: Yet, heard is a video store the size of a city.
It keeps 950 shots from 105 films. Every film is a tower, every shot a floor, every frame a window.
Its 8 streets are the scenes of the poem, in order: the first is “Rooftop gaze toward distant mountains”.
The tallest tower is Straight Talk (1992): 36 floors.
Nothing in it is older than 1906 or newer than 2015.
The sign most often read here is vector.
